"""Measure full6M display/replay and helper delays; reuse checked canonical data."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.mesh_scale_check import check_display, load_expectation
from experiments.mesh_scale_measure import ProgressPrinter, measure_worker, save_report
from experiments.mesh_scale_metrics import host_record
from experiments.mesh_scale_run import implementation_record, outside_git, published
from scansor.mesh_worker_request import WorkerRequest
from scansor import mesh_supervisor

PROBE=Path('/tmp/scansor-37-process-observer-timing-probe.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('timing_observer_probe', PROBE)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)


def main():
    base=outside_git(Path('/home/data/scansor-s6-evidence-fJVNUiYN'))
    name='grid-3000x2000-flat-display-observer-timing-r1'
    root=base/name
    output=base/('run-'+name+'.json')
    telemetry={op:base/(name+'-'+op+'.ndjson') for op in ('display','verify-display')}
    if any(p.exists() for p in (root,output,*telemetry.values())):raise FileExistsError(name)
    raw=(base/'run-grid-3000x2000-flat-512-gc-observer-switch1-r1.json').read_bytes()
    prior=json.loads(raw)
    assert prior['checks']['canonical']['status']=='verified-complete-canonical-data'
    first,first_id=published(prior['operations']['import'],'import')
    second,second_id=published(prior['operations']['import'],'contribution')
    expected,frozen_sha=load_expectation(base/'expected-grid-3000x2000-flat.json')
    implementation=implementation_record()
    sources={str(p):{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source':p.read_text()}
             for p in (Path(__file__),PROBE,module.HELPER)}
    report={'revision':'independent-sampler-timing-diagnostic-v1','status':'failed','case':name,
            'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'scope':'Fresh sequential6M display/replay workers at512MiB, reusing independently checked import/contribution. Worker code e3 unchanged. Two sampler helpers prestarted and included in separate6GiB cgroup charge, excluded from workerRSS. Per-iteration helper clocks, schedstat and rusage instrumentation may alter timing. Last128 delayed intervals are retained; full count is separate. No performance speedup or full-import result claimed.',
            'implementation':implementation,'diagnostic_sources':sources,
            'input_report_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            'frozen_manifest_sha256':frozen_sha,'expectation':expected,
            'import_id':first_id,'contribution_id':second_id,'operations':{},'checks':{}}
    started=time.monotonic_ns()
    original=mesh_supervisor.ProcessObserver
    try:
        root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        (root/'work').mkdir(mode=0o700)
        (root/'out').mkdir(mode=0o700)
        module.POOL.extend(module.Helper() for _ in range(2))
        mesh_supervisor.ProcessObserver=module.Observer
        def measure(request):
            index=len(module.USED)
            op=measure_worker(request,root,telemetry[request.operation])
            helper=module.USED[index]
            op['outcome']['supervision']['sampling_method']='Diagnostic prestarted independent Python helper using held proc statm descriptor; helper wall/CPU/scheduling timing retained; parent alone reaps worker.'
            op['sampler_process']={'pid':helper.process.pid,'exit_code':helper.process.returncode,
                                   'error':helper.error,'slow_samples':helper.gaps}
            report['operations'][request.operation]=op
            if op['status']!='complete' or not op['observations']['whole_worker_rss_within_budget']:
                raise RuntimeError(request.operation+' failed; inspect retained outcome')
            return op
        displayed=measure(WorkerRequest('display',first,contribution=second,destination=root/'out',
                expected_import_id=first_id,expected_contribution_id=second_id,budget_bytes=512*1024*1024,storage='disk'))
        third,third_id=published(displayed,'display')
        report['checks']['display']=check_display(third,expected,display_id=third_id,import_id=first_id,
                contribution_id=second_id,progress=ProgressPrinter())
        measure(WorkerRequest('verify-display',first,contribution=second,display=third,
                expected_import_id=first_id,expected_contribution_id=second_id,expected_display_id=third_id,
                budget_bytes=512*1024*1024,storage='disk'))
        if implementation_record()!=implementation:raise RuntimeError('worker code changed')
        for p,value in sources.items():
            if Path(p).read_text()!=value['source']:raise RuntimeError('diagnostic changed')
        report['status']='complete'
    except BaseException as error:
        report['error']={'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)[:2048]}
    finally:
        mesh_supervisor.ProcessObserver=original
        for helper in module.USED:helper.finish()
        for helper in module.POOL:helper.finish(unused=True)
        report['helpers_exited']=all(h.closed and h.process.returncode==0 for h in [*module.USED,*module.POOL])
        report['elapsed_including_checks_ns']=time.monotonic_ns()-started
        report['host_after_checks']=host_record(base)
        save_report(output,report)
    print(json.dumps({'status':report['status'],'report':str(output),'helpers_exited':report['helpers_exited']}),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if report['status']=='complete' and report['helpers_exited'] else 1)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Independent sampler-process diagnostic; e3 worker and core sources unchanged."""
import array
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from experiments import mesh_scale_run
from experiments.mesh_scale_measure import save_report
from scansor import mesh_supervisor
from scansor.mesh_process_observer import RssObservations

HELPER = Path('/tmp/scansor-37-rss-sampler-timing-prototype.py')
PACK = struct.Struct('!c6Q')
POOL = []
USED = []


class Helper:
    def __init__(self):
        self.channel, child = socket.socketpair(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            [sys.executable, str(HELPER), str(child.fileno())],
            pass_fds=(child.fileno(),), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        )
        child.close()
        self.channel.settimeout(5)
        try:
            assert self.channel.recv(16) == b'R'
        except BaseException:
            if self.process.poll() is None:
                self.process.kill()
            _, stderr = self.process.communicate(timeout=5)
            self.channel.close()
            raise RuntimeError('sampler bootstrap failed: ' + stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
        self.channel.setblocking(False)
        self.final = False
        self.error = None
        self.gaps = []
        self.observed = RssObservations(0, 0, None, None, 0, 0, None)
        self.closed = False

    def drain(self):
        while True:
            try:
                message = self.channel.recv(2048)
            except BlockingIOError:
                break
            if message[:1] == b'G':
                self.gaps.append(json.loads(message[1:]))
                continue
            if message[:1] == b'E':
                self.error = message[1:].decode()
                continue
            tag, peak, samples, first, last, largest, misses = PACK.unpack(message)
            assert tag in (b'P', b'F')
            self.observed = RssObservations(peak, samples, first, last, largest, misses, self.error)
            self.final |= tag == b'F'

    def finish(self, *, unused=False):
        if self.closed:
            return
        if not self.final:
            try:
                self.channel.send(b'Q')
            except (BlockingIOError, BrokenPipeError, ConnectionRefusedError):
                pass
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while self.process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
            if not unused:
                self.drain()
            time.sleep(0.001)
        if self.process.poll() is None:
            self.process.kill()
            self.error = 'sampler did not stop'
        self.process.wait()
        if not unused:
            self.drain()
            if not self.final:
                self.error = 'sampler exited without final observations'
        if self.process.returncode:
            self.error = 'sampler failed: ' + str(self.process.returncode)
        assert self.process.stderr is not None
        error = self.process.stderr.read(4096)
        self.process.stderr.close()
        if error:
            self.error = error.decode(errors='replace')
        self.channel.close()
        self.closed = True
        if self.error:
            x = self.observed
            self.observed = RssObservations(x.peak_bytes, x.samples, x.first_ns, x.last_ns,
                                            x.largest_gap_ns, x.gaps_over_10ms, self.error)


class Observer:
    def __init__(self, process, sample_seconds):
        self.process = process
        self.interval = round(sample_seconds * 1_000_000_000)
        self.helper = POOL.pop(0)
        USED.append(self.helper)

    def start(self):
        now = time.monotonic_ns()
        descriptor = os.open(f'/proc/{self.process.pid}/statm', os.O_RDONLY)
        try:
            rss = int(os.pread(descriptor, 256, 0).split()[1]) * os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE')
            self.helper.observed = RssObservations(rss, 1, now, now, 0, 0, None)
            fds = array.array('i', [descriptor])
            self.helper.channel.sendmsg(
                [struct.pack('!3Q', now, rss, self.interval)],
                [(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SCM_RIGHTS, fds)],
            )
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)

    def observations(self, *, check=True):
        if not self.helper.closed:
            self.helper.drain()
            if self.helper.process.poll() is not None:
                self.helper.drain()
                if not self.helper.final:
                    self.helper.error = 'sampler exited prematurely'
        if check and self.helper.error:
            raise RuntimeError(self.helper.error)
        return self.helper.observed

    def reap(self, options):
        # Held proc FDs remain bound to the original process after PID reuse:
        # https://docs.kernel.org/filesystems/proc.html
        return os.wait4(self.process.pid, options)

    def stop(self):
        self.helper.finish()


def smoke():
    import psutil
    POOL.append(Helper())
    process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-c', 'import time; x=bytearray(32000000); time.sleep(3)'])
    observer = Observer(psutil.Process(process.pid), 0.001)
    observer.start()
    time.sleep(0.05)
    before = observer.observations()
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    _ = math.factorial(200_000)
    finished = time.monotonic_ns()
    after = observer.observations()
    process.terminate()
    _, status, _usage = observer.reap(0)
    process.returncode = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
    observer.stop()
    final = observer.observations()
    print(json.dumps({'parent_c_call_ns': finished-started, 'samples_before': before.samples,
                      'samples_after': after.samples, 'gap_ns': final.largest_gap_ns,
                      'peak': final.peak_bytes, 'error': final.error}))
    assert after.samples > before.samples + 20 and final.error is None


def main():
    root = Path('/home/data/scansor-s6-evidence-fJVNUiYN')
    name = 'grid-3000x2000-flat-512-process-observer-r1'
    final = root / ('diagnostic-' + name + '.json')
    if final.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(final)
    source = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    helper_source = HELPER.read_bytes()
    original = mesh_supervisor.ProcessObserver
    measure = mesh_scale_run.measure_worker
    def measured(*args, **kwargs):
        index = len(USED)
        result = measure(*args, **kwargs)
        helper = USED[index]
        result['outcome']['supervision']['sampling_method'] = 'Diagnostic prestarted independent Python helper, held proc statm descriptor, cumulative datagram updates; parent alone calls wait4.'
        result['sampler_process'] = {'pid': helper.process.pid, 'exit_code': helper.process.returncode,
                                     'error': helper.error, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(helper_source).hexdigest()}
        return result
    try:
        POOL.extend(Helper() for _ in range(3))
        mesh_supervisor.ProcessObserver = Observer
        mesh_scale_run.measure_worker = measured
        report = mesh_scale_run.run_case(
            root / 'expected-grid-3000x2000-flat.json', root / 'source-grid-3000x2000-flat.ply',
            root, name, root / ('run-' + name + '.json'), budget_bytes=512*1024*1024, storage='disk',
        )
    finally:
        mesh_supervisor.ProcessObserver = original
        mesh_scale_run.measure_worker = measure
        for helper in USED:
            helper.finish()
        for helper in POOL:
            helper.finish(unused=True)
    result = {'revision': 'independent-process-observer-prototype-v1',
              'scope': 'Complete6M flat pipeline with a diagnostic independent sampler process replacing the parent sampling thread. Worker code is fixed e3. Three lightweight helpers are prestarted before the first worker, used one per operation, and included in cgroup charge but excluded from measured worker RSS. All helper processes must exit. Not an uninstrumented timing comparison.',
              'probe_source': source.decode(), 'probe_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
              'helper_source': helper_source.decode(), 'helper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(helper_source).hexdigest(),
              'helpers_exited': all(h.process.returncode == 0 and h.closed for h in [*USED,*POOL]),
              'case_report': report}
    save_report(final, result)
    print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'diagnostic': str(final), 'helpers_exited': result['helpers_exited']}), flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0 if report['status'] == 'complete' and result['helpers_exited'] else 1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if '--smoke' in sys.argv:
        smoke()
    else:
        main()

"""Diagnostic helper: sample a held proc statm FD without parent Python locks."""
import array
import errno
import json
import resource
from collections import deque
import os
import socket
import struct
import sys
import time

PACK = struct.Struct('!c6Q')


def main():
    channel = socket.socket(fileno=int(sys.argv[1]))
    channel.send(b'R')
    payload, ancillary, flags, _ = channel.recvmsg(128, socket.CMSG_SPACE(4))
    if payload == b'Q':
        return
    if flags or len(payload) != 24 or len(ancillary) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('invalid sampler bootstrap')
    level, kind, raw = ancillary[0]
    assert level == socket.SOL_SOCKET and kind == socket.SCM_RIGHTS
    descriptors = array.array('i')
    descriptors.frombytes(raw)
    assert len(descriptors) == 1
    descriptor = descriptors[0]
    first, peak, interval = struct.unpack('!3Q', payload)
    last, samples, largest, misses = first, 1, 0, 0
    page = os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE')
    channel.setblocking(False)
    error = None
    gaps = deque(maxlen=128)
    previous = None
    sched = os.open("/proc/self/schedstat", os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        while True:
            cycle = {"loop_start_ns": time.monotonic_ns()}
            try:
                command = channel.recv(16)
                if command == b'Q':
                    break
                raise RuntimeError('invalid sampler command')
            except BlockingIOError:
                pass
            now = time.monotonic_ns()
            cycle["sample_start_ns"] = now
            try:
                raw = os.pread(descriptor, 256, 0)
            except OSError as caught:
                if caught.errno == errno.ESRCH:
                    break
                raise
            if not raw:
                break
            cycle["read_end_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
            cycle["thread_cpu_ns"] = time.thread_time_ns()
            cycle["schedstat"] = [int(v) for v in os.pread(sched, 256, 0).split()]
            usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
            cycle["rusage"] = [usage.ru_nvcsw, usage.ru_nivcsw, usage.ru_minflt, usage.ru_majflt]
            fields = raw.split()
            if len(fields) != 7 or len(raw) >= 256:
                raise RuntimeError('invalid statm record')
            rss = int(fields[1]) * page
            gap = now - last
            if gap > 10_000_000:
                gaps.append({"gap_ns": gap, "previous": previous, "current": dict(cycle)})
            largest = max(largest, gap)
            misses += gap > 10_000_000
            peak = max(peak, rss)
            samples += 1
            last = now
            try:
                channel.send(PACK.pack(b'P', peak, samples, first, last, largest, misses))
            except BlockingIOError:
                # Every update is cumulative. A full IPC buffer must not pause
                # sampling; the final update is delivered after parent drainage.
                pass
            cycle["sleep_start_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
            time.sleep(interval / 1_000_000_000)
            cycle["sleep_end_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns()
            previous = cycle
    except BaseException as caught:
        error = f'{type(caught).__name__}: {caught}'[:1000]
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
        os.close(sched)
        channel.settimeout(5)
        for record in gaps:
            channel.send(b"G" + json.dumps(record, separators=(",", ":")).encode())
        if error is not None:
            channel.send(b'E' + error.encode())
        channel.send(PACK.pack(b'F', peak, samples, first, last, largest, misses))
        channel.close()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

fields.coordinates: source float32 widened to float64, then the recorded display-only transform
fields.rejected_vertex_values: area, weight and vertex statuses still describe the source vertex, which may also belong to usable faces
fields.scalar_raw_area: authoritative source vertex area, in unknown source-coordinate squared units
fields.scalar_source_corner: original zero-based corner 0, 1 or 2 of the rejected source face
fields.scalar_vertex_status: 0=finite-position; nonfinite positions have no display location
fields.scalar_weight: dimensionless triangle-area-mean-one-v1 weight; not a solver weight
fields.source_digits: four successive 16-bit source row ID digits, least significant first, each exactly representable in binary32

legend.omission_access: Authoritative source vertex and face row queries retain all nondisplayable records; no coordinates are invented.

precision.viewer_preservation: requires a separate measured viewer round-trip report

legend.source_normals: retained in authoritative data; omitted from PLY views to avoid viewer normalization implying measurement preservation
legend.topology: Every usable source face retains winding and multiplicity after index remapping; source maps bind original export row order.

transform.meaning: display-only; not calibration or physical units

weight_ramp.measure: raw accumulated vertex area divided by complete eligible maximum

phase_totals.scope: Worker phase boundary intervals; I/O includes telemetry/IPC and observations have explicit start/end windows. Startup and post-monitor cleanup are covered separately by whole-worker supervision.

display.scope: Whole-worker kernel RSS/CPU/fault counters include startup through exit. Parent telemetry, file sampling, and subsequent independent artifact validation are outside worker RSS. Cgroup charge can include the parent, file cache and other listed members; it is not RSS. The cgroup kernel peak may predate this operation. A completed operation does not by itself pass resource or sampling-coverage observations.

disk.scope: Sampled file lengths and st_blocks for the entire owned run root, including completed outputs. Filesystem-wide metadata/journal space is excluded; non-atomic samples are lower bounds on intervening peaks.

host_after.cache_conditions: Uncontrolled host/page cache; no global cache drop. Source preparation and other host activity can affect cache residency.
